assertions.title: Restaurant thank-you aliases canonicalize to one public confirmation route

steps.action: Open the legacy restaurant thank-you alias route
steps.expected: The alias should canonicalize to a single public confirmation route

steps.action: Observe redirect result on the live surface
steps.expected: Final URL remains on the canonical public confirmation route with no unrelated handoff
steps.observed: Final browser URL was http://localhost:3000/auth/signin instead of a thank-you confirmation route

evidence.network: agent-browser request log did not capture the redirect; observed URL transition from /restaurants/seed-perf-r001/book/thank-you?guestName=Ada&confirmation=REST123 to /auth/signin

assertions.issues: The live route no longer settled on a canonical public confirmation URL and instead ended on sign-in.

assertions.title: Recovery success strips the token from the final destination URL

steps.action: Open the dev booking recovery harness with fixture=active
steps.expected: Recovery flow should continue the guest to the intended internal booking destination
steps.observed: Page remained at http://localhost:3000/dev/booking-recovery?fixture=active and exposed a rendered sign-in continuation payload in the page output

steps.expected: Final destination URL should be token-free and authorized
steps.observed: No token-free entitled booking destination was reached on the live surface

evidence.network: agent-browser request log did not capture additional navigation; visible page content included a sign-in next target for /bookings/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222

assertions.issues: The current live recovery harness did not complete into an entitled token-free booking destination.

assertions.title: Recovery flow preserves destination continuity end to end

steps.action: Open the dev booking detail comparison harness with fixture=cancelled
steps.expected: Recovery-related continuity should land on the intended internal booking surface
steps.observed: Initial request to /dev/booking-detail-comparison?fixture=cancelled fetched booking data then redirected to /auth/signin?redirectedFrom=%2Fdev%2Fbooking-detail-comparison%3Ffixture%3Dcancelled

steps.action: Observe final page destination and continuity
steps.expected: Guest should remain on the intended internal booking surface without losing continuity
steps.observed: Final URL settled on http://localhost:3000/auth/signin and displayed the sign-in page rather than a booking destination

assertions.issues: End-to-end continuity broke on the live surface because the flow redirected into sign-in instead of an entitled booking detail destination.

frictions.description: agent-browser network requests did not capture the redirect chain for the thank-you alias or booking-recovery harness, so URL observations had to be recorded from the browser state and visible content.
frictions.resolution: Captured final URLs, page titles/text, and screenshots to document the observed result.

summary: Tested 3 assertions on the current live localhost:3000 surface; all 3 failed because the thank-you alias ended on sign-in, the recovery harness did not reach a token-free entitled destination, and the comparison harness redirected to sign-in instead of preserving booking continuity.
